linkedRange: 0x002001-0x007fff; includes C runtime, model, platform wrapper, base-page backup, IO mailboxes, buffers and static stack
basePage: 0x000200-0x0002ff; rc0..31 at physical 0x0202-0x0221; copy scratch 0x0222-0x0229; all 256 bytes saved in linked BSS across KERNAL
kernelContext: 0x000000-0x0015ff captured opaquely in linked .noinit before C base-page initialization; wrapper saves application page 1 and B=2 page, restores KERNAL 0002-15ff, uses SP=01ff for KERNAL, then restores the complete application hardware stack/SP and base page before C return
kernelDosSnapshot: 0x054000-0x055fff, 8192 bytes; opaque entry-time DOS context; private lifecycle-only resource staging, no reserve use
callMarkers: 0x001f10-0x001f11, temporary call-entry/return indices during KERNAL phase; original application contents restored from lowCaptureBackup
softwareStack: 0x00c000-0x00cfff; top 0xd000; isolated proof overlay, not production allocation
hotCapture: 0x000300-0x001fff preserved around KERNAL; result published at 0x001900-0x0019ff after return
kernalCompatibility: 0x000002-0x0000ff, 0x000300-0x0015ff; initialized through public APIs, no private-field reconstruction
dosWorkspace: 0x010000-0x011fff; synthetic application pattern backed up before KERNAL and restored after it; independent pattern CRC
dosBackup: 0x01d000-0x01efff, 8192 bytes of existing shared transient workspace; exclusive during quiescent proof handoff
romStores: 0x020000-0x03ffff; 131072 bytes, destructive synthetic fill only after verified backup, then full restoration
kernalDma: KERNAL-owned during exclusive storage phase; not concurrent with application DMA
irqNmi: IRQs masked; NMI/RESTORE invalidates proof; canonical resident vectors reinstalled before C return
